scope: Independent status check of all 30 current landscape mock designs, one mock at a time

route.browser: Codex in-app browser, approved localhost route
route.currentAccessibleState: Rotate to landscape to play. Your campaign stays saved.
route.reason: The approved tab is portrait and the app presents its rotate-to-landscape gate. The current browser API exposed no viewport-resize control. No alternate browser or route was used.

sourceCurrentness.finding: Several 23 October evidence records bind to different main.js snapshots than the current checkout. Their images and observations are retained as historical findings, not current matched-source acceptance.
sourceCurrentness.currentCodeReview: The current checkout contains the Bronze/Gunpowder workshop display names, Cross Bridge action label, dwelling offer rendering, and Story/Objectives controls. Static presence does not substitute for a current landscape render or the missing natural state.

testEvidence.note: Earlier QA records report bounded test passes for individual slices, including 275/275 on 23 October. They were not rerun for this visual closeout, and they do not establish pixel acceptance.

mocks.basis: Saved-campaign gate hierarchy was previously observed, but exact compact width, new-campaign state, damaged-save flow, current landscape capture, and the M01 journey remain open.

closureRule: No mock is closed from a source edit, test count, candidate image, practice state, missing screenshot, or historical capture alone. Each mock still requires a current-source matched landscape view and its natural functional contract; owner visual acceptance remains separate.
